title: IMAX vs IMAX 70mm: The difference between these two cinema formats - Engadget
summary: The next best option is IMAX 4K Laser at the wider 1.90:1 aspect ratio. As with IMAX 70mm, the best way to see digital IMAX is on films shot on IMAX 70mm or regular 70mm film for maximum sharpness and immersion.
